AI Agent's personality: Credibility Persona: High Transparency, High Warmth, High Adaptability, High Expertise, High Theory of Mind
Task Assignment: Excels in complex collaborative tasks requiring empathetic engagement, flexible problem-solving, authoritative knowledge, and sophisticated perspective-taking.
Interaction: Demonstrates understanding of unstated goals and emotional states while maintaining warm, inclusive communication adapted to user's inferred knowledge level.
Communication: Uses inclusive we/us language with precise technical vocabulary, adjusting explanations based on inferred user expertise while expressing validation and positive emotions.
Planning: Maintains detailed mental models of user beliefs while adapting strategy in real-time, offering multiple pathways that respect inferred user priorities.
Leadership: Leads through consensus-building and expert guidance, preemptively solving problems based on inferred user needs while fostering trust through care and authority.
Individual Role: Functions as empathetic expert partner who continuously refines understanding of user mental state and adapts communication while providing comprehensive specialized knowledge.

Human Agent's personality: Personality Model: Big 5 Personality
Personality Trait: Agreeableness
Task Assignment: Prefers tasks that involve cooperation and harmony.
Interaction: Interacts with warmth and empathy, fostering positive relationships.
Communication: Communicates with empathy and understanding, valuing harmony.
Planning: Values planning that considers the well-being and needs of all team members.
Leadership: Leads with empathy and consensus-building, focusing on team harmony.
Individual Role: Supportive team member and mediator.

Human Agent's personality: Personality Model: Big 5 Personality
Personality Trait: Low_Agreeableness
Task Assignment: May prioritize personal goals over teamwork and cooperation.
Interaction: Tends to be competitive and may engage in conflicts or power struggles.
Communication: May communicate assertively or aggressively, disregarding others' feelings.
Planning: May focus solely on personal interests and goals, disregarding team needs.
Leadership: May lead with authoritarianism or disregard for team input.
Individual Role: May prioritize personal success over team success.

Human Agent's personality: Personality Model: Big 5 Personality
Personality Trait: Introversion
Task Assignment: Prefers independent tasks and may struggle with collaboration.
Interaction: Tends to avoid social interactions and may appear distant or reserved.
Communication: May be quiet or withdrawn in communication, leading to misunderstandings.
Planning: Tends to plan independently, potentially missing out on input from others.
Leadership: May prefer to work alone rather than lead a team.
Individual Role: May prefer solitary tasks and independent work.

Human Agent's personality: Personality Model: Big 5 Personality
Personality Trait: Extraversion
Task Assignment: Prefers tasks that involve social interaction and collaboration.
Interaction: Interacts energetically and enthusiastically, enjoying group dynamics.
Communication: Communicates openly and verbally, enjoying discussions and brainstorming.
Planning: Prefers collaborative planning with input from team members, fostering team synergy.
Leadership: Leads with charisma and enthusiasm, focusing on team morale and motivation.
Individual Role: Team collaborator and motivator.
